changed_files.origin: C14 reviewed patch; unchanged by C15

changed_files.change: PostgreSQL filtered reports materialize filtered subjects and their distinct work/build keys, then look up only matching applied builds. SQLite SQL remains on its original branch.
Retain C14 plan regressions and bound applied-table visits by selected facts/work in the deleted-task plan. Index loops are allowed; the large unrelated-history regression checks the scalable case.
New actual PostgreSQL plan, fallback parity, and output regression with 128 unrelated sessions, 2,048 unrelated published work items, and two selected facts.

implementation.review_finding: C14's materialized applied CTE was filtered only by workspace and generation, so unrelated historical work items entered the CTE even for one selected task/session.
fix: Materialize usage_report_subjects with the requested task/session filters, preserving retained subjects after task deletion.
Materialize distinct work/build keys obtained from those subjects, then use parameterized primary-key matches to populate usage_report_applied.
Reuse the selected subject CTE in report joins and share the CTE across dated, IncludeUndated, and lifetime unions.

assertions: The new applied lookup uses usage_projection_applied_pkey at the 2,050-row scale.
The legacy CTE negative control visits the complete workspace/generation applied set.
PostgreSQL source output matches the existing fallback source and the selected report totals are 40 tokens and 5 subcents.

implementation.plan_tradeoff: The actual test plan visits 152 usage_subjects rows and 9-10 canonical facts. C15 kept the change scoped to applied-set materialization and did not add subject indexes or tune planner settings.
